header: Six ways to reach the same support team
subheader: No first-line team passes you on. Whoever answers has installed tills themselves.
lead: If your till has stopped, call us. For everything else email is usually faster, because we can check the history first.
note: On 24 and 31 December the phone line is open until noon. It is closed on all other public holidays.

channels.title: Telephone
channels.description: +43 732 90 90 12, Monday to Friday 8am to 5pm, Saturday until noon.

channels.title: Email
channels.description: hallo@aichbrunn-kasse.at, answered within one working day, usually the same morning.

channels.title: Help pages
channels.description: Instructions and explanations of every error message, available at any time.

channels.title: Status page
channels.description: Current faults and planned maintenance, so you can see if the problem is on our side.

channels.title: Service counter, Linz
channels.description: Wiener Straße 44, Monday to Friday 9am to 4pm. Bring your till, no appointment needed.

channels.title: User forum
channels.description: Other shops often answer faster than we do. You can read without an account.
